newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HARRIS SCARFE SAYS SALES RISE 15.9 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HARRIS SCARFE SAYS SALES RISE 15.9 PERCENT.

text.p: Department store retailer Harris Scarfe Holdings Ltd said on Monday that sales in 1996/97 (July/June) rose by 15.9 percent to A$236.5 million from A$204 million last year.
The company said the latest period consisted of 53 weeks compared with 52 weeks in 1995/96, representing a 17.7 percent rise in sales on a comparable basis.
On a like-for-like basis, sales rose by 3.5 percent.
"The increase is particularly satisfying considering we have made an effort to reduce the number of 'discount type' sales in this financial year," managing director Ron Baker said.

"The reduction in discount sales has had a positive impact on the gross profit percentage achieved by the company in the 1996/97 year. The impact of this will be announced in our profit statement due late September," Baker said.
